_comment: Configuration for the 'event-modeling-agents-watch' scheduled task. Edit this file to change what the weekly watch looks for. The task reads it at the start of every run. Add/remove items freely; keep it valid JSON.
_scope_options: Each watch axis has its own scope. 'focus-only' = capture only items touching the listed topics (a narrow net for on-target material). 'anything-substantive' = capture any notable new post regardless of topic, flagging off-thread items in the report (used for the people watch, where the value is the author, not the keyword match).
